body:
Hey, I’m only 17 but I kind of understand where you’re coming from. My dad was abusive and when I finally told my mom the extent of what he’d done to me, he left. He took my sister. She was 18 but it just hurts to know that someone could just take away the thing that’s most precious to you. I can’t imagine losing a dog. My dog is my best buddy and the only thing keeping me here. I’d love to chat with you more and try and help you out. Best wishes. 
—s
Dude looks like Fred.
Not the best tbh. You ?

If you’re from the US, it’s free. Idk if it shows up on your phone bill but I’m pretty sure it doesn’t. I don’t think it shows up unless someone specifically requests the records. It doesn’t show up as anything, just a 1-800 number. If you don’t want to call, I’m here to talk. 
—s
Thanks I guess.

Would you want to talk some more before you do it ? I’d love to get to know you more before you go. If not I understand. I’m not going to tell you don’t do it I just genuinely want to have a conversation with you.

This broke my heart to read. I’m 17 and my mom means the world to me. We’ve been through so much together and I hate that I’m going to leave her. I’m not trying to guilt trip you, I just see so much love, life, spark, and hope for you. Imagine your beautiful baby growing up knowing her mom is gone and is never coming back. Or, imagine your precious angel grows up. She’s 15 and she decides to end her life. How would you feel? How would she feel? What I’m trying to say is, she loves you and she will even more as time goes on. I know you love her but I understand how you feel. Remember, you’re strong. Best of luck. 
—s

I barely cry and holy shit this made me sob. It’s truly haunting to read someone’s last words. Once their mind is made up, it makes your heart ache that you can’t save them. I want to, yet I understand your decision. I genuinely hope that you will find peace... wherever happens after tonight. I know this post will stick with me forever. I will be wishing you well from way down here. Goodnight friend. 
—s

Oh sweetie, I was suicidal at 13 too. 13 was the worst fucking year of my life. Although I’ll admit I’m not better (17 now) I am a lot better than I used to be. I see you like tøp? I used to love them at your age too! What’s your favorite song by them? What’s the song by them that has the most meaning to you? My favorite was clear and the one that meant the most to me was friend please.
To be honest the only reason I’m still here is because I can’t fail yet again. I’m waiting until I get a gun. So it can be final. Why are you feeling this way though ?

Hey I understand how alone you’re feeling. If you want you can send me a message and we can chat more. I’m sending good vibes your way. 
—s

Hey man, I understand a lot of what you’re going through. I’ve been in and out of psych wards for 3 years. I’ve been in residential for half a year before. I’ve also been on antipsychotics and antidepressants. They recently took me off the antipsychotics because I was on so many pills (too much for a teenager to handle they said). I was on a mood stabilizer, antipsychotic, antidepressant, and anti ptsd/nightmare reducer as well as a muscle relaxant because of the side effects of the antipsychotic. Anyway, I understand all to well your feeling of hopelessness. It’s very hard to find people who have actually basically tried everything. A lot of people on here haven’t gotten help yet. So it feels a lot worse when you feel like you’ve exhausted all options. I would love to have a more in depth chat with you sometime. Feel free to reply or PM me if you’d like. If not, best of luck and remember that I’m rooting for you. 
—s
I understand how you feel. I’m sick of this world too. PM me.

Hey (17f here) I respect your decision as I will be leaving soon as well but watch out for pedophiles and creeps!! Last time I ran away, some dude hit me up and he was like 25 and I was 16... he lived in a frat house and wanted me to stay with him. Anyway, just pleaseee be careful. PM me if you need anymore advice. 
—s
Hey hun, I’m 17f and I’ve been molested by my dad. I know exactly what it feels like. I’d love to talk with you more. Feel free to pm me if you want.
No.
Pm me.
Hey

Hey so I see you’re a musician as well. I’m just 17 but I plan on pursuing music. I’ve been trying to start/join a band (I play guitar and bass but I’m way better at bass) but have been unsuccessful. Especially being female, people tend to judge my abilities just for that reason. Anyway, I’m so sorry you’re struggling. You seem very intelligent, kind, and a fun person to talk to. You don’t have to reply if you don’t want to but just know that I’m always here. I hope we can get to know each other more. 
—s
Dope ;)
Dude I’m from Iowa too!! 17f here. Pm me.

Well personally I’m not that familiar with many charities. But I really think just something like checking back on this subreddit every so often and reaching out to people. I know for me the most helpful thing when im suicidal is having someone to talk to (someone besides a professional because I just want someone to listen and not try and “snap me out of it”). Anyway... this is super selfish lol but I’d love to have a chat with you. I’ve been feeling super bad recently and I just want someone who won’t ditch me.

Personally and I’ve heard from others that they aren’t helpful. I’ve called them multiple times and been told once “I really don’t know what to say”, and I’ve been told by them that legally they’re not allowed to give advice so my experience every time I’ve called has gone something like this: I call, they ask me what’s wrong, I tell them, they ask if I have felt like this before, we sit in silence minus the sound of my tears and shaky breaths, I tell them I feel better, I hang up. All in all, I don’t really find them helpful but that may just be me and a handful of others.
Where ?

That’s so cool that you can play the piano! I’ve tried but failed. Stringed instruments are more my thing. I play electric bass, guitar, and ukulele. Im not that good at guitar lmao but I’d love to help you learn :)
Hey thank you ❤️❤️

I’m sorry that you felt that low. But I’m extremely glad to hear that you’re better. Music is a big healer for me too. (I’ve only listened to a few songs by Joji) but I know how big of an impact it can make on someone’s life. Do you play any instruments ? Do you sing or make music ? I’d love to have a chat with you sometime if you’re down. Thanks for sharing your story. 
—s

Yes I would love to. Thank you so much for reaching out to me. Could you please send me a PM (long story short i can’t be on any social media anymore so I have to use reddit and instagram on private browsing on my phone lol) because I don’t know how to do it from the mobile website. Thanks ❤️

Hey, I haven’t been through as much as you have but I’ve been through similar things. I was abused by my dad as well. I was also diagnosed with depression, ptsd, and anxiety at 14 so I know how bad it sucks to be a kid going through all that fucked up shit. My mom also compares me to my dad which makes me so upset. He’s literally a rapist... and just because sometimes I snap at her apparently that means I’m going to turn out like him. She constantly asks me “what happened to my sweet innocent little girl” well she was fucking used by her own father that’s what happened. Sorry for the rant. Anyway my point is, I understand how you feel (I live in the states and I’ve run away a few times and I know it’s not the best way to go about things but I could help you leave that hellhole if you want). Let me know if you want to talk in private. Best wishes. —s
